question: What permission-set licence allocations, usage and expiry dates are reported?

steps.name: licenses
steps.soql: SELECT DeveloperName, MasterLabel, Status, TotalLicenses, UsedLicenses, ExpirationDate FROM PermissionSetLicense ORDER BY DeveloperName LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: {licenses.rows} row(s) returned by the first query. Review selected columns, query limits and follow-up steps; this is not an org-wide assessment.

traps: Permission-set licences differ from user licences. Availability alone does not grant access.
Zero or special totals need separate interpretation; expiry is date-based.
